notes: Draft open course. Official event results identify the 967 metre hillclimb. The single independently named source path measures approximately 961.5 metres; the supplied 1029 metre scalar differs. Approximate planar OSM trace distance 961.5 m. Both private timing positions agree with existing source endpoints. No artificial closure or missing connector is invented; one-way source tags remain unchanged and event direction remains provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 64 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. This standing-start run begins at the first paired edge station and ends at the last; original timing metadata are retained. Finish speed is unconstrained, with no stopping zone modelled. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
